result.title: Orders: reserve stock before confirming an order
result.description:
order-service now reserves stock with inventory-service before it confirms an order. Unit tests pass.
System components: api-gateway (routes client requests to order-service); order-service (validates, prices and confirms orders on a worker pool); inventory-service (holds stock for an order).
Semantic-layer rows for this system have system_id = 'w-c5h2'; other values belong to unrelated systems.
result.diff:
--- a/services/orders/handler.py
+++ b/services/orders/handler.py
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@ def handle_order(request):
     order = validate(request)
     price(order)
+    inventory.reserve(order.items)  # hold stock before confirming
     return confirm(order)
